entry.disclosure: FIRST MEASUREMENT of this .5 serving version . SAME WEIGHTS AS Gen2 (no earlier-generation KnowLine row exists on the board): the shards, tokenizer, configuration and chat template are byte-identical to the predecessor; the new author layout reads short text inputs twice, so this measures a new serving version, not new weights. AUTHOR'S OWN SERVER on our rented hardware, bf16. NATIVE OUTPUTS: label-token logprobs, label-only softmax at temperature 1; choice argmax, Noul P(true), score expectation; header off, no rotation or calibration file. AUTHOR EXPOSURE (card, self-reported, not verified): the authors adopted read twice after checking their own evaluation sets and a fresh full run of the Decision Index 0.3 public suite; the card also reports JevBench / JevBench-hard evaluations. Training-data, Decision Index format-data and decontamination disclosures are inherited from Gen2; no overlap or contamination audit was run by us. The authors say no Jev or other decision-model outputs were used as training labels. The author's H20 timing does not transfer to this RTX PRO 6000 measurement. 10 s RULE: 15 decisions took 12.0-13.7 s (maximum 13.691 s), exactly the 15 standard very long positions, and are scored wrong under the 10 s rule in the v1.7 share view (the frozen v1.6 and v1.7-off views apply no time limit) (median 0.0789 s, p95 0.1089 s). DETERMINISM: first 50 positions run twice, 0/50 bit-identical, 0 argmax flips, maximum probability difference 0.0077745; bit reproducibility is not established and the cause was not investigated. CONTEXT: SGLang configuration limit 262,144 tokens; no author-imposed lower cap, no truncation and 0 refusals; the longest item was 81,706 tokens. The measurement runner's internal time cap fired about 1.4 seconds before the scored loop ended. An independent review found the answer file complete: all 1,500 requests were answered, with token usage equal to the offline count. The runner's partial flag is retained in the measurement record. The answer file was lost on 26 Oct 2026 after scoring. These are the scores and confidence intervals computed on 23 Oct; the measurement cannot be scored again. Subject-topic and use-case breakdowns are unavailable. The Noul decisiveness diagnostic is unavailable because the stored summaries do not record which timed-out answers were decisive.
